legacy_cells.B: An Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Variant Evidence Interpretation
legacy_cells.I: 067_2025_An Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Variant Evidence Interpretation.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Given evidence features for a genetic variant, what probability supports assigning it a pathogenic classification?
legacy_cells.AI: Synthetic tabular variant features: GuRu score, population frequency, and gene-risk indicator
legacy_cells.FM: An actor-critic reinforcement-learning framework using genomic evidence features to estimate variant classification probabilities, evaluated on synthetic data.
legacy_cells.FN: AUC values exceeded 0.8 in some settings; performance varied with learning rates and label-noise level. The results also report calibration plots and improving training reward/decreasing TD error.
legacy_cells.FO: The authors state that highly accurate data representation and validation with real-world data remain necessary; the study uses simulated data.
legacy_cells.FP: Apply the RL methods to empirical genomic data and further integrate Bayesian frameworks.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence is limited to simulated variant classification. The reported discrete feature state and benign/pathogenic classification actions do not demonstrate a temporal health-state transition, alternative treatment rollouts, causal treatment effects, or clinical utility.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pages 1–21: title/abstract and introduction (pp. 1–3); methods (pp. 4–6); results and figure captions (pp. 7–15); discussion and stated limitations/future work (pp. 16–17); conclusion (p. 18); references (pp. 19–21). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I were retained as supplied. The paper uses an explicit discrete variant-feature state and classification action within an actor-critic algorithm, but no transition of a healthcare state is evaluated; the discrete state is not evidence of a world model. Evaluation is on generated synthetic data. Numeric AUC detail is stated only as exceeding 0.8 in some settings; no metric was calculated from figures. No unreadable extraction issues noted. Evidence QA: 23/25 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (92%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 25 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Synthetic data only; R1 technical feasibility, not R2 retrospective clinical validation.
AUC>0.8 exact configuration unresolved and preserved raw.
ROC Figure6 specificity label and0→1 orientation warrant code audit.
No clinical benefit or independent reproduction.
